title: Lemon Bars
description: A buttery shortbread crust topped with a bright, tangy lemon custard and a snow of powdered sugar. Sharp, sweet and sunny.
scaleNote: A single batch fits an {len 8x8 in} pan; a double batch fits a {len 9x13 in} pan with a few extra minutes of baking.

image.alt: Lemon bars dusted with powdered sugar

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven}. Line the pan with parchment, leaving an overhang on two sides.
Stir the flour, powdered sugar, salt and melted butter into a soft dough and press it evenly into the pan. Bake until pale golden at the edges, {time 18-20 min}.
Meanwhile whisk the eggs, sugar and flour until smooth, then whisk in the lemon zest and juice.
Pour the filling over the hot crust and bake until the center is set and no longer jiggles, {time 20-25 min}.
Cool completely in the pan, then chill for at least {time 2 hr notimer}. Lift out, dust with powdered sugar and cut into {count 16} squares with a knife wiped clean between cuts.

notes: Bars keep 4 days in the fridge. Dust with powdered sugar just before serving; it dissolves over time.
